component.name: BuonApp
component.summary: Free, open-source POS for cafes and restaurants

ul.li: A graphical floor map with rooms, joined tables, and saved layouts
Service days with an explicit close and a printed end-of-day report
Reservations for the service in progress, assigned straight onto the map
Kitchen tickets printed by round and routed to per-category stations
A cover charge carried by head count onto the bill
Set menus at one price, written into the order as real dishes
Thermal ESC/POS printing over USB, local network, and OS print queues
Tableside ordering from handhelds on the same local network
An optional Kitchen Display System with real-time updates
Works offline — no subscription, no cloud account, no telemetry

description.p: The interface was rebuilt around **where things live**, not around how they look. The screen that used to be the till is called *Order* and no longer takes money: the till here is the machine standing next to the computer, so calling a screen after it was a lie about the room. A bill is drawn up, cashed, discounted and reprinted where the order is — at the table in the floor plan, or in the service day for takeaway and delivery — and an order is closed from one place only. Two things a table service needs arrived: the **cover charge**, which had a counter but no price, and the **fixed menu**, which the catalogue could not describe at all. One thing left: **splitting a check between guests**, which was never a screen so much as a second shape for the whole billing side.

Quitting the app never actually finished. Every shutdown — from the menu, the tray, or a signal — spent ten seconds waiting on connections that could not answer, then gave up partway through cleanup, before the database was closed. The process that stayed behind held Electron's single-instance lock, and the next launch quit on the spot without saying why.

The taxation module is gone. This install never issued a fiscal document — the bill it prints is a preconto and the receipt comes from the till standing next to it — so an engine that resolved country rules, signed publisher packs, and apportioned tax evidence across split checks in integer minor units was weight carried for nothing. Roughly 16,000 lines lighter, with no printed total changed.
New application icon and logo for the BuonApp fork, in two variants so small sizes stay legible. Removed the remaining upstream Flo artwork.

First release of the BuonApp fork, turning a general-purpose cafe POS into a restaurant floor tool: service days, a multi-room graphical table map, reservations, joined tables, saved floor plans, and kitchen tickets sent in rounds. Removed the cloud bridge, the usage telemetry, and the statistics dashboard.

Multi-arch Linux distribution publishing: snap-store + AppImageHub auto-discovery + arm64 AppImage, deb, rpm, snap. Migrated snap config to core24 + GNOME extension. Fixed strict-confinement plug list (network-bind, screen-inhibit-control). Release history after this point is appended automatically by `scripts/update-metainfo.js` at release time.

Fixed: Paying a prepaid order in full marks it completed immediately. Standalone KDS item status changes broadcast live over WebSockets. Removed unused customer deletion endpoint. Added keep-me-logged-in option, payment method breakdown in dashboard, and cart editing improvements.
Latest release with Linux improvements and bug fixes.
